stop_condition: Done when the ART_PREFIX_HEAD/ART_PREFIX_TAIL partition and its scoped extractors have been examined ONCE for an input yielding an undeclared key=value, a mis-computed boundary, or a partition failure returning a value rather than refusing; then either a finding at or above high, or verdict=approve with findings=[]. BOUNDED: no exhaustive proof of absence. fkm.1.1 must still exit 4; i8cx must still resolve iteration=10/sol-codex.

findings.evidence: The accepted record `REVIEW-ARTIFACT v1 iteration=7 reviewer=sol-codex model=gpt-5.6-sol pin=gpt-5.6-sol reviewed_hash=abc risk_threshold=high verdict=findings stopped_by=verdict findings=[R7-F1:high,findings=[] at 2026-09-03T00:00:00Z: summary` produced a nonempty ART_PREFIX and correctly partitioned HEAD/TAIL, but the scoped sed extractor returned ART_FINDINGS empty. The grammar at line 2271 permits the bracket content `R7-F1:high,findings=[`; sed's greedy `.*findings=\[` therefore starts at the nested undeclared token and consumes the sole closing bracket.
findings.description: The partition excludes bracket content only from the other field extractors; ART_FINDINGS retains the same unanchored greedy mechanism. A record author can include an undeclared nested `findings=[` in the permitted findings content and make a declared high finding parse as no findings, directly changing the gate outcome.
